create_Raymarcher: create a Raymarcher instance with a given volume radius and step size for volumetric rendering
run_Raymarcher_forward: run the Raymarcher forward pass with ray positions, directions, and decoded primitive outputs to render RGB and alpha
render_with_shadow: render a scene using Raymarcher forward with shadow computation enabled via the with_shadow flag
filter_valid_primitives: filter and render only valid volumetric primitives by passing a valid_prims mask in the decoded output dictionary
review_Raymarcher_forward: review the Raymarcher forward method to understand how it extracts primitive positions, rotations, scales, and templates for ray marching
